summary: apply.c:check_leash is absent from the JavaScript movement path. The C function processes attached inventory leashes only when the hero step increases the pet distance: within three squares it does nothing; otherwise a non-breathless cursed leash chokes/damages the pet, an uncursed or breathless leash snaps loose beyond five squares, and closer movement prints “You pull on the leash.” and spends rn2(3) before the pet sound. C calls it from ordinary domove, failed-untrap movement, and after random teleport when next_to_u fails. JavaScript lacks the normal movement implementation, leaves a note_unported in move_into_trap, and has a mislabeled gap after teleport.c:tele, which remains unported.

source.branch: For each carried LEASH with nonzero leashmon, resolve the monster and compare squared hero-to-monster distance before and after the proposed position; only an increase is processed. At Chebyshev distance at most 3 return without effects. Beyond that, cursed non-breathless leashes damage or kill the pet; otherwise distance greater than 5 releases it, while closer movement pulls and may draw rn2(3) for a non-silent pet.
callers: hack.c:domove_core:2962 calls check_leash(u.ux0,u.uy0) after u_on_newpos and hide/mimic handling, before movement success, redraw, vision and spoteffects; js/hack.js:domove_core has no call at the matching point.

trap.c:move_into_trap:5413 calls check_leash(u.ux0,u.uy0) after u_on_newpos and vision_recalc, before move_bc and trap/spoteffects; js/trap.js:move_into_trap currently has note_unported("apply.c check_leash") there.

allmain.c:moveloop_core:314 calls check_leash(old_ux,old_uy) only after tele() changes coordinates and next_to_u() returns false; js/allmain.js still notes teleport.c:tele as unported and then has a mislabeled note_unported("dog.c check_leash").
dependencies: light.c:find_mid (find the carried leash target by id)
hacklib.c:dist2 and apply.c:um_dist (movement-distance and radius tests; existing JavaScript helpers)
mon.c:xkilled (already implemented JavaScript kill path; C discards its return)
do_name.c:mon_nam and Monnam, pline.c:pline_mon, sounds.c:growl/yelp/whimper (existing JavaScript output paths)
rng.c:rnd and rn2 (use the active operation random source when supplied; otherwise core RNG)
